title: Where Are You
speaker: Pastor Wayne Holcomb
description:
Where Are You | Surrender, Nearness to Christ, Obedience, and the Shepherd's Care - John v10:7-11

Jesus is the Good Shepherd, and in Him we are not lacking anything. From John v10:7-11, we see that He is both the door and the protector of His sheep, laying down His life so we can be saved and kept. The question is not whether He is faithful, but whether we are staying near to Him or drifting toward the edge where temptation, compromise, and self-will grow stronger.

In John v6, many walked away when His words became hard, but Peter answered, _"To whom shall we go?"_ Christ alone has the words of eternal life. Through 1 John v4:9-11, we are reminded that God's love is fully revealed in Jesus, who turned away wrath by giving Himself for our sins. Nearness to Christ means more than receiving help in trouble; it means surrendering all, trusting His will, and letting His love flow through us to others.
